editors.description: Selected editors; preserves settings, keybindings and extensions

workstation.starship_config:
add_newline = false
format = '$directory$git_branch$git_status$cmd_duration$line_break$character'

[directory]
truncation_length = 1
substitutions = [
  { from = '([^/]{20})[^/]+', to = '${1}…', regex = true },
]

[git_branch]
format = '[$symbol$branch]($style) '
truncation_length = 24
truncation_symbol = '…'

[cmd_duration]
format = '[$duration]($style) '

[character]
success_symbol = '[❯](bold green)'
error_symbol = '[❯](bold red)'

web.description: JS/TS workstation with Node, pnpm, browser, Compose and SQL clients

python.description: Python/uv workstation with native extension builds, SQLite and quality tools

project-managed.description: Developer workstation with browser, Docker, build tools and SQL clients; projects own runtime versions
